title: GitLab merge-request approval rules evidence file
description: Merge-request approval posture for a GitLab project. Place at .oss-policy-kit/evidence/gitlab-mr-rules.json. Consumed by GL-PIPE-011. Trust level: self-attested unless populated by collect-evidence --platform gitlab.

schema_version.description: Schema identifier for this evidence file format.

attested_at.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the maintainer last verified these settings.

attested_by.description: GitLab username or identifier of the person attesting this file.

project.description: GitLab project path (group/project) or numeric project id this evidence applies to.

min_approvers.description: Highest required-approver count across the project approval setting and named approval rules.

code_owner_approval_required.description: Whether code-owner approval is required on the default branch or via an approval rule.

reset_approvals_on_push.description: Whether existing approvals are reset when new commits are pushed.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes about deviations or context.
